fact: A contract worth USD 480,500 for consultancy services to develop the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture (GLEA) and e-Government interoperability (E-GIF) Framework was awarded, as published on 17 October 2025.
title: Awarded - Consultancy services for the development of the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture (GLEA) and e-Government interoperability (E-GIF) Framework - Lesotho
